messages:
maria: Hey team — I opened a docs PR for the private deployment networking guide. It's focused on using a bastion / egress proxy with SNI routing in air-gapped sites. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :github: 
kp-docs: Thanks — saw the PR. Two quick asks: 1) can we add a minimal nftables + iptables example for the proxy host? 2) an explicit note about split-DNS + private CA for SNI. Right now we only have linux examples for nat-based networks.
alex: I can drop a short nftables snippet. For the proxy host (port 443 -> local APP), something like:

```
# nftables (very minimal)
table ip filter {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; ct state established,related accept; iifname "lo" accept; tcp dport 443 ct state new accept; }
  chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
}
```

Also add a note for SYSCTL net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 if the host is routing.
jin: Re: private CA + SNI: we need to be explicit about certificate chains when customers terminate TLS at the proxy vs when they pass through. Add a short section: 
- If TLS is terminated at the proxy, proxy must present cert chain trusted by the service (or install CA in the service nodes).
- If using TLS passthrough, ensure SNI and ALPN are preserved and the proxy doesn't strip the TLS record.

Also mention PKCS#11 HSM considerations when the proxy uses keys stored in HSM (some HSM agents restrict key export so you must configure the TLS stack to reference the PKCS#11 URI).
kp-docs: Good points. Can you suggest 2-3 one-liners we can paste into the docs for the HSM bit? I'm trying to keep the section under 'proxy configuration' compact.
jin: Sure, copy/paste candidates:
- "When using an HSM for proxy TLS keys, configure the TLS library to use your PKCS#11 provider and reference keys by PKCS11 URI (e.g., pkcs11:token=redwood;object=bastion-cert)."
- "If the HSM agent disallows private key export, ensure the proxy supports PKCS#11 engine integration (e.g., OpenSSL engine_pkcs11 or NSS PKCS11 module)."
- "For on-prem air-gapped installs, bundle the PKCS#11 provider RPM into the offline artifact and document version pinning for compatibility."

maria: Perfect, I'll paste those. One more: customers sometimes run the proxy on a Windows bastion. Do we want a Windows example?
alex: Minimal netsh example for Windows Server (HTTPS redirect to local port):

```
# run as admin
netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=443 listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectport=8080 connectaddress=127.0.0.1
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Allow443" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=443
```

kp-docs: Nice. Can you also add a tiny troubleshooting checklist for when SNI routing fails (e.g., verify SNI header via tcpdump, confirm proxy preserves TLS ClientHello, check split-DNS resolution)? Keep it 3 bullets.
alex: I'll add: 
- tcpdump -nni <iface> 'tcp port 443' and inspect ClientHello SNI with tshark
- curl --resolve to force DNS and test upstream connectivity
- check proxy logs for TLS handshake errors / ALPN mismatches

ops-bot: CI for PR #4123 — docs linter: passed, linkcheck: failed (2 broken links). See report: https://ci.redwood/links/4123
kp-docs: Which links? I can patch quickly.
maria: The two broken links are to our old 'kms-hsm quickstart' article — those moved. I'll replace with new anchors and add redirects note.
security-team: Quick flag: when you mention 'bundle provider RPM' please add a short security note about verifying package signatures in offline installs. We need a one-sentence recommendation to verify GPG sigs before install.
kp-docs: Will add sentence: "Verify offline package GPG signatures prior to installation; see verify-packages.md for commands."
maria: Great — thanks everyone. I'll push an update with the nftables snippet, Windows netsh, the HSM one-liners, the tiny troubleshooting bullets, and the signature verification note. I'll also re-run linkcheck. Expect a follow-up in ~30m. :thumbsup:
kp-docs: LGTM, ping me when linkcheck is green and I'll merge.
alex: FYI I tested the nftables snippet in a minimal VM and it behaved as expected.
maria: Update: pushed changes & fixed the two links. Re-running CI now.
ops-bot: CI for PR #4123 — all checks passed :white_check_mark: 
kp-docs: Merged. Thanks team! :tada:
